It would be helpful if a `ValueError` was raised when trying to do that.

fix select macro to process 64 branches

Closes #4501

## Motivation

Fix the bug wherein select macro fails with input of 64 branches.

## Solution

Fix the count macro to handle 64 branches. Before the fix, count macro will not expand when the input has 64 branches and will fail with compile error.

Allow disabling time auto-advance behavior in tests

Closes #4522. See that issue for a more extensive approach.

## Motivation

Some programs have background tests that use sleeping for timings while working with IO. Testing such programs with auto-advancing time is currently quite complicated, as it's not possilbe to time the IO correctly..

## Solution

This PR adds a way to disable the auto-advance behavior, so that tests can directly manage time using `time::advance`. It's simply a boolean flag, which is checked when time would be auto-advanced otherwise.

rt: implement initial set of task hooks

This change implements two hooks for per-task actions, one which is invoked on task spawn, and one which is invoked during task termination.

These hooks initially are only supplied with the task ID (on unstable only), but more information can be added in the future, as the struct used to supply parameters is opaque.

Fixes #3181.
Record recovered panics in c.Errors. The default recovery handler should attach the recovered panic as a private error.
Context.Copy should preserve Errors and Accepted fields so goroutines observe existing errors and content-negotiation state.
